title: Volunteer Trail and Habitat Restoration Crew Member
organization: San Dieguito River Park, San Diego River Park Foundation
description: Volunteer trail and habitat restoration work with multiple organizations in San Diego County.
duties: Operates shovels, McLeods, picks, loppers, and hand saws to brush trail corridor and maintain tread
Identifies and manually removes invasive species
Assists with fencing and rockwork projects
Hauls rocks, soil, and trash under direction of rangers and staff
Co-leads nature preserve hikes and riparian trash removal events
